cards.label: Bermondsey — James's unit
cards.text: Owen is at the bench with a cutting board of his own, labelled in James's handwriting. He looks up, then back down, very quickly.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "He has reached the second level. Slower than a gifted student, faster than I told him he would. I did not tell him that."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "And you have built a workshop. With your own money, in your own home, where you have to look at it every morning. That is what I meant by serious."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "So that's market and money. You said two things."
He turns the hourglass over and watches it run out before he answers.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "Very well. I join properly. I stop taking a share for nothing and start making the goods the share comes from. Give me ore and a target in Production and I will meet it."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "My own clients remain mine. I will do their work on my own time. If either of you so much as offers them a discount, I will know."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Full partner. Look at that. I'd hug you, but."
James writes his own name on Owen's board, one line above Owen's. It is the closest thing to a contract anyone is going to get.
